---
title: "Fit a mixed model to a Polars table and chart it"
include-in-header: _phiz-scripts.html
---

Read a CSV file with Polars, fit test scores with a random intercept for each school, and chart each school's fitted line with phiz.

The example needs the phpolars extension ([phpolars installation](https://phpolars.phpstats.org/docs/deployment)) and phiz (`composer require phpstats/phiz`). phit can be the extension or the plain-PHP polyfill ([Extension or polyfill](../extension-or-polyfill.qmd)). The [complete script](https://github.com/phpstats/phit/blob/main/docs/examples/scripts/polars-mixed-model.php) includes the Composer bootstrap.

## Data

The data are 250 simulated students in 12 schools, in [`docs/data/schools.csv`](https://github.com/phpstats/phit/blob/main/docs/data/schools.csv). `score` is a test score in points, and `study_hours` is time spent studying, in hours. Save the file beside the script:

```sh
curl -O \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phit/main/docs/data/schools.csv
```

{{< include _generated/polars-mixed-model.md >}}

## Interpretation

- `scan_csv()` starts a lazy query, `select()` keeps three of the file's four columns, and `collect()` runs it. `toColumns()` copies the result into PHP arrays, one per column. `fit_mixed_gaussian()` and `Plot::of()` both accept an object with `toColumns()` and would each call it themselves, so the script converts once and passes the arrays to both.
- `fit_mixed_gaussian()` fits by REML, as `lme4::lmer()` does by default. The `study_hours` coefficient is the difference in score associated with one more study hour within a school. The school SD measures how much school intercepts vary around the average intercept.
- `fitted` holds the conditional fitted values, which include each school's predicted random intercept. Fixed-effects-only predictions are in `fixed_fitted`.
- The model gives every school the same slope, so the twelve fitted lines are parallel and differ only in their intercepts.
- The script saves the chart as a standalone page, `schools.html`.

**See also:** [Fit a mixed model](mixed-model.qmd) for reading the variance components and school effects · [Mixed models](../mixed-models.qmd) for the supported structures · phpolars' [Getting started](https://phpolars.phpstats.org/docs/getting-started) · phiz's [Get started](https://phiz.phpstats.org/docs/get-started)
